sources.source: AmazingData historical_codes and stock_basic; SSE listing/type notices
sources.required_semantic: Effective-dated A-share common-stock identity, exchange, latest listing/relisting and lifecycle end for every security-day
sources.available_coverage: Two historical universe dates (2024-01-02: 5096; 2026-09-22: 5222) plus five stock_basic samples and an ETF negative control
sources.missing_evidence: Full contiguous effective-dated identity intervals, a tested relisting case, authoritative security type for every member and full date-by-date coverage
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: HistoricalUniverse and RSI prefix cannot include/exclude every security-day without future or current-master leakage
sources.minimum_next_action: Freeze a bounded daily historical A-share list and effective-dated lifecycle/type table, validate IPO, delisting, relisting and ETF exclusions against exchange notices

sources.source: AmazingData SH/SZ calendars; SSE/SZSE annual closure notices
sources.required_semantic: Exact SSE/SZSE sessions for next_trade_date and session clocks
sources.available_coverage: 2024-01-01 through 2026-09-23: 662 exact sessions on each exchange, zero missing/extra or inter-exchange differences
sources.missing_evidence: None within validated window; earlier years are not claimed qualified
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: Does not block within validated window; any earlier warm-up needs separately validated sessions
sources.minimum_next_action: Use a study start no earlier than 2024-08-15 for a 150-session buffer, or extend official validation before that window

sources.source: AmazingData checked_bars with Gate B volume/amount unit contract
sources.required_semantic: Frozen raw OHLCV/amount for every selected security-day with correct historical date and reproducible snapshot
sources.available_coverage: Three checked 600519.SH bars on 2024-06-18 through 2024-06-20; four additional 2015 bars in a separate diagnostic
sources.missing_evidence: Full bounded universe-date bar snapshot, completeness/outage reconciliation, raw and normalized artifact hashes and aggregate row/security counts
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: Indicators, limit-up counts, execution and forward paths lack complete frozen observations
sources.minimum_next_action: After D5 qualification, capture an exact bounded OHLCV/amount universe snapshot and reconcile missing dates to D1/D6

sources.source: Gate B canonical DailyTradingConstraint contract and AmazingData historical status inputs
sources.required_semantic: Per security-day valid, limit_applicable, regime, price limits and trading_allowed with conflict exclusion
sources.available_coverage: Gate B C2 contract CLOSED; no real bounded-range canonical output or regime totals
sources.missing_evidence: Full-range VALID/INVALID/MISSING/CONFLICT and 10%/5%/20%/no-limit counts; resolution of a sampled ST-label conflict
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: Real limit-up eligibility and order intent cannot be replayed safely
sources.minimum_next_action: Produce canonical constraints from qualified effective-date status and bars; tally all regimes and fail closed on conflicts

sources.source: AmazingData backward_factor and issuer corporate-action announcements
sources.required_semantic: PIT-safe factor(d)/factor(T) for every signal T, or sufficient effective-date official-action reconstruction
sources.available_coverage: One security: 8730 overlapping dates across two post-action retrievals unchanged; two cash/bonus action ratios match six-decimal rounding bounds
sources.missing_evidence: Pre-vs-post later-action factor snapshots, or broad reconstruction covering rights/share-scale and multiple actions, plus full-universe target-window coverage
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: PIT_ADJUSTED_CLOSE_V1 can contaminate RSI/MA/Entry if future corporate actions alter historical ratios
sources.minimum_next_action: Obtain a true pre-action factor snapshot for ratio invariance, or reconstruct representative single and multiple action sequences from official effective-date terms; then freeze universe-wide factors

sources.source: AmazingData history_status(IS_SUSP_SEC), checked bars, issuer suspension notice
sources.required_semantic: Per security-day TRADED, SUSPENDED, NOT_LISTED, LIFECYCLE_ENDED or UNKNOWN without treating missing bar as suspension
sources.available_coverage: Three 600519 status/bar days and four 600518 status days including an issuer-confirmed suspension on 2024-07-03
sources.missing_evidence: Full bounded universe-date status/bar joins, conflict and UNKNOWN counts, effective-date reconciliation of vendor status flags
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: Suspended or unknown days could be misread as tradable, corrupting membership, fillability and observation clocks
sources.minimum_next_action: Freeze daily status for the qualified universe, join to bars/lifecycle, validate a wider suspension sample and report every UNKNOWN/conflict

sources.source: Private calendar/factor captures and probe receipts
sources.required_semantic: REAL_RESEARCH_SNAPSHOT_V1 with every source hash, request, retrieval time, code commit and contract version
sources.available_coverage: Calendar capture and two single-security factor files have private hashes; no complete cross-source study snapshot
sources.missing_evidence: Security master, bars, canonical constraints, factor, state and action snapshot receipts tied to one study range
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: Live re-query could silently change historical inputs, preventing deterministic replay
sources.minimum_next_action: Freeze all qualified source artifacts locally and issue a single immutable run manifest with raw/normalized hashes and coverage counts

sources.source: Existing ForwardEventStudy adjustment-factor path and issuer company-action evidence
sources.required_semantic: ENTRY_COMPARABLE_FORWARD_PATH_V1: realized future price-scale actions only in outcome, not in signal; PRICE_PATH_V1 excludes cash dividend income
sources.available_coverage: Contract and synthetic future-action/PIT guard test; two published action terms; no complete company-action outcome source
sources.missing_evidence: Full bounded action chronology, entry-date comparable high/low/close validation including rights/multiple actions, source hashes
sources.why_it_blocks_signal_reconstruction: Does not block signals directly, but prevents economically comparable MFE/MAE/RET after entry
sources.minimum_next_action: Freeze effective-date action source for every candidate event horizon and validate comparable path against official cash, bonus, rights and multiple-action examples
